text:
Maya (People Ops): Ethan flagged his April paystub. He9s in Paris but it shows US FICA withheld AND French social charges. Can payroll/mobility confirm residency for Apr pay period 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30?

Paystub excerpt:
```text
Gross: EUR 6,200
CSG/CRDS + Social: EUR 1,180
FICA (US): USD 230
Net: EUR 4,540
```
Link: <https://payroll.redwood/secure/stubs/EthanR/2026-04>

Ethan R.: I relocated to Paris on 2026-03-15. Mobility confirmed my French contract effective 2026-03-20 and I provided carte de se9jour/SIRET. I thought US payroll stopped after March paycheck.

Jin (Payroll): Can you share Payrun ID and GID? I9ll check country code and payroll feed timing.

Claire (Payroll Ops): Payrun PR-20260430-77, GID RWF-6219. System shows country_code=FR for employee, but the exported file to payroll provider included FICA_US element due to legacy flag `retain_us_tax=true` on the employee profile. Looks like a config oversight.

payroll-bot: Ticket #PAY-11888 created: "Ethan R - double social/FICA on France payroll". Assigned Claire. <https://payroll.redwood/tickets/PAY-11888>

Luc (Global Mobility): I have Ethan9s mobility file: arrival 2026-03-15, mobile start 2026-03-20, residence docs uploaded 2026-03-18. He meets French tax residency for April. We should not be withholding FICA for April.

Tom (Tax): If FICA was withheld incorrectly, payroll can reverse the FICA and refund Ethan. If reversal occurs after year-end, we9ll need to issue a W-2c. Also check employer-side filings. Recommend payroll reverse FICA this month and provide journal entries.

Claire (Payroll Ops): Plan: 1) Post reversal for FICA_US in PR-20260430-77 and run a net correction to restore Ethan9s net. 2) Notify benefits/401k vendor if deferrals were applied. 3) Start employer reclaim if any double employer contributions occurred. ETA: reversals by EOW.

Jin (Payroll): Once done send GL entries to payroll-recon. Also confirm whether any US-state withholding posted accidentally.

Ethan R.: Thanks everyone. Appreciate not being out-of-pocket. I9ll DM any additional residency docs if needed.

Maya (People Ops): Action owners: Claire 99999999999999: reverse FICA + net correction; Luc: confirm mobility docs in ticket; Tom: monitor W-2 impact; Jin: reconcile. Will update Ethan by EOW.
